title: Resolve nested record component types before choosing a JSON adapter
summary: Moshi resolved nested scalars, lists and map values to Long. Alternating Long, String and Long wrappers in the same adapter cache preserved the type of every component.

change.description: Resolve each record component in its enclosing parameterized type so list and map adapters receive the concrete type argument.

notes: Identical raw component declarations can represent different parameterized types. Reusing the same adapter cache exercises that distinction.
